Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner compared the death dates incorrectly, focusing on month/day (November 22 vs December 5) and ignoring the years. Lesley Selander (Knights of the Range) died on December 5, 1979, which is earlier than Georges Lautner’s death on November 22, 2013. This led to the wrong conclusion that Lautner died first.
